name: Presque Isle County, MI
findings: Presque Isle County has 66 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (61% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Presque Isle County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
44% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Presque Isle County list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
